title: Wallet initialize frontrun
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, attack to secretly own new wallets of other users  **Likelihood:** Medium, frontrun required  ## Description  The deploy script does 2 transactions to deploy a wallet:  1. deploy contract 2. call initialize() (which accepts the first controller)    (foundry, every call is a transaction)  ```         address _newWalletAddr = _factory.createProxy(_testWalletSalt);         Main(payable(_newWalletAddr)).initialize(deployer); ```  Wallet deployments can be tracked and awaited. An attacker can frontrun and call `initialize()` with malicious input.  One of the ideas:  1
